title: Capstone: Key-Value Database
description:
```
kv> SET user:1 "Ann"
OK
kv> GET user:1
"Ann"
kv> EXPIRE user:1 30
kv> KEYS user:*
kv> SAVE
```

> [!info] Part of this project happens outside Xenon
> Write and run the code here: Xenon builds every `.cpp` in the explorer into one program. The first requirement asks for a CMake build with separate targets, which you set up on your own machine once the code works (lesson [[10.09 Build Systems and CMake]] shows how). Keep the library, the command line and the tests in separate files from the start so that step is easy.
requirements: CMake project with a `kvcore` library + `kvcli` executable + a tests executable *(on your own machine)*
Storage: `std::unordered_map<std::string, Value>` where `Value` is a variant (string, int, list)
Commands: `SET GET DEL EXISTS INCR KEYS(pattern) EXPIRE TTL SAVE LOAD`
TTL with `<chrono>`; lazy expiry on access
Persistence: append-only log file + snapshot; recover after "crash"
Benchmarks: ops/sec for SET/GET with 1M keys
